"""
Abstract interfaces for the database layer to decouple plugins from concrete implementations.

This module defines ABC-based interfaces for database operations, promoting:
- Testability: Mock implementations can satisfy interfaces for unit tests.
- Maintainability: Concrete implementations (e.g., MongoDB) can evolve independently.
- Analyzability: Clear contracts make dependencies easier to trace.
"""

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List, Tuple, AsyncIterator
from pyrogram.types import Message as PyroMessage


class IMediaRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for media/file operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save_file(self, media: PyroMessage) -> Tuple[bool, int]:
        """
        Save a media file to the repository.

        Returns:
            Tuple[bool, int]: (success, status_code)
                success: Whether the operation succeeded.
                status_code: 1 for new save, 0 for duplicate, 2 for error.
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_search_results(
        self,
        query: str,
        file_type: Optional[str] = None,
        max_results: int = 10,
        offset: int = 0,
        filter: bool = True
    ) -> Tuple[List[Any], Optional[int], int]:
        """
        Fetch search results matching the query.

        Returns:
            Tuple[results, next_offset, total_count]
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_file_details(self, file_id: str) -> List[Any]:
        """Fetch details for a specific file_id."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def count_documents(self, filter: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        """Return the number of documents matching a filter."""
        pass


class IUserRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for user operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_user(self, user_id: int, name: str) -> None:
        """Add a new user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def is_user_exist(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if a user exists."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def total_users_count(self) -> int:
        """Return total number of users."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def ban_user(self, user_id: int, ban_reason: str) -> None:
        """Ban a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def unban_user(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Remove user ban."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_ban_status(self, user_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get ban status for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self) -> Tuple[List[int], List[int]]:
        """
        Get banned users and disabled chats.

        Returns:
            Tuple[List[user_ids], List[group_ids]]
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_user(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete a user record."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_users(self) -> AsyncIterator[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Yield all users."""
        pass


class IGroupRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for group/chat operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_chat(self, chat_id: int, title: str) -> None:
        """Add a new chat/group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get chat settings or status."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_settings(self, chat_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get chat settings, with defaults."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def update_settings(self, chat_id: int, settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Update chat settings."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def disable_chat(self, chat_id: int, reason: str) -> None:
        """Disable a chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def re_enable_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        """Re-enable a chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def total_chat_count(self) -> int:
        """Return total number of chats."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_chats(self) -> AsyncIterator[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Yield all chats."""
        pass


class IConnectionRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for group-connection operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_connection(self, group_id: int, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Add a group connection for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def active_connection(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[int]:
        """Get active group ID for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def all_connections(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[List[int]]:
        """Get all group IDs connected to a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def if_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if a specific group is active for the user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def make_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Set group as active for user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def make_inactive(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Clear user's active group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_connection(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Remove a group connection for a user."""
        pass


class IFilterRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for group filters."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_filter(self, group_id: int, text: str, reply_text: str, btn: str, file: str, alert: str) -> None:
        """Add/update a filter for a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def find_filter(self, group_id: int, name: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str, Optional[str], str]]:
        """
        Find a filter by name.

        Returns:
            Optional[Tuple[reply_text, btn, alert, file_id]]
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_filters(self, group_id: int) -> List[str]:
        """Return all filter keywords for a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_filter(self, group_id: int, name: str) -> None:
        """Delete a specific filter."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_all_filters(self, group_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete all filters for a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def count_filters(self, group_id: int) -> int:
        """Return the number of filters in a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def filter_stats(self) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """
        Return (total_collections, total_filters_count).
        """
        pass
